name: VIRALA Dusk
status: Website (branch website-soft-2026-10-27). The app adopts it only after Founder approval and an HQ record.

dusk.role: Signature. Primary buttons, the hero signup card, the Premium card, deep bands, the footer.

rose.role: The ONE accent, exactly the same on every ground (porcelain, Dusk, dark mode). Only for large italic accent words in headlines (24 px and up). Never small text: numbers, labels, links and citations are ink on light grounds and porcelain on dark.

peach.role: Glow only: the soft light inside the hero card, the Meet Vira band and the footer, and the mark's back page. Never text.

ink.role: All text on light grounds. No light-grey body text anywhere.

porcelain.role: Page ground; text and buttons on Dusk.

duskLight.role: The lighter end of Dusk gradients.

duskDeep.role: The deep end of Dusk gradients.

depth.glow: THE SIGNATURE (as on Instagram): soft peach and rose light inside deep Dusk, in three places only: the hero signup card, the Meet Vira band, the footer. A small bright core fading out (a wide faint glow turns grey on blue): radial-gradient(520px 380px at 84% 0%, rgba(240,178,156,.5), rgba(232,166,177,.22) 42%, transparent 72%), radial-gradient(460px 340px at 6% 104%, rgba(232,166,177,.26), transparent 68%) over the deep band
depth.deepBand: linear-gradient(168deg, #283F58 0%, #23384F 45%, #18263A 100%) (plain, for every other deep section)
depth.deepCard: radial-gradient(320px 280px at 96% 2%, rgba(240,178,156,.62), rgba(232,166,177,.26) 42%, transparent 74%), radial-gradient(360px 300px at 0% 100%, rgba(232,166,177,.22), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(160deg, #2A425C 0%, #23384F 50%, #1B2B3E 100%) (the hero card; the Premium card uses the plain card gradient)
depth.pageGlow: radial-gradient(1100px 640px at 100% -12%, rgba(243,220,213,.5), transparent 62%) over porcelain, behind the first screen only
depth.photoBand: photo graded saturate(.85) contrast(.95) under a deep Dusk vignette where the text sits: radial rgba(27,43,62,.82 to .22) and linear rgba(44,69,96,.3) to rgba(27,43,62,.55); white text, rose italic; contrast measured from pixels
depth.rule: Alternate clearly between porcelain sections and deep Dusk sections; no pale in-between bands. Rose is the one accent. If it starts to look decorated, it is too much.

display.licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (Google Fonts), free for web and app
display.use: Headlines, card titles, numbers, the footer line. Italic for accent words.
display.settings: weight 440 for h1/h2 (420 italic), 400 for h3, 450 for list and card titles at 18-24 px; optical sizing on; tracking -0.02em at display sizes

text.licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (Google Fonts), free for web and app
text.settings: weight 400 body, 500 navigation, 600 buttons and labels; labels uppercase with 0.14em tracking

scale.body: 16-17 px (line-height 1.55; articles 16-18 px at 1.68, about 68 characters)
scale.label: 12.5 px uppercase

type.spacing: Section padding 56-96 px; compact cards with short lines; no tall empty cards. A page should be taken in without heavy scrolling.
type.app: In the app, Newsreader for display and titles; Hanken Grotesk or SF Pro for UI text, following Dynamic Type.

mark.shape: The Life Chapters mark: three pages, unchanged geometry (brand/logo/virala-mark.svg).
mark.use: Header, footer, favicon, welcome, social card, 404, Instagram profile, app icon. One mark; no other colourways.

viraSymbol.symbol: A · Page Spark: VIRALA's own sparkle, built from the mark's soft page curves, with one small companion spark low on the left.
viraSymbol.listening: The companion spark gently brightens; nothing spins. Static when the visitor prefers reduced motion.
viraSymbol.use: Vira page (large, in a soft glow), Premium card, Meet Vira band, welcome. Never in a box on the website. How Vira answers is not decided, so no conversation or chat screen is shown anywhere yet.

icons.primary: brand/icon/app-icon-dusk.svg (Dusk gradient, the mark on Dusk) — matches the favicon and Instagram
icons.ios: brand/icon/AppIcon.appiconset (Any: Dusk, Dark, Tinted); PNGs in brand/icon/png. Not applied to the app.

photography: Calm and real: soft sea, sky, mist, linen, windows, a notebook. Topic-matched in the Journal.
No faces, no hand-only close-ups, no fruit, no visible text or logos.
Graded softly towards Dusk (cooler, slightly desaturated); never filtered to look fake.
Text on a photo only over a Dusk vignette, with contrast measured from the rendered pixels.
Licences: Unsplash free licence (or owned), id and photographer recorded in review/PHOTO_RIGHTS_MANIFEST.md.
instagram: Deep Dusk posts with the glow, porcelain Newsreader headlines and one rose italic phrase (#C47784); porcelain posts with ink and rose italics. Peach only inside the glow.
The mark small in a corner; the Vira sparkle only on Vira posts.
Same photo rules as the website.

contrast.use: Rose italic accent words on porcelain (24 px and up only)
Rose italic accent words on cards (24 px and up only)
Text on the lightest stop of the deep gradients
Rose italics on the deep band (its lightest stop)
Rose italics on the deep card (its lightest stop)
Porcelain button label on Dusk (ink on porcelain)
